item.title: Indian, US navies kick off 5-day specialised diving, EOD exercise in Kochi
item.summary: In a significant show of unity, the Indian and US navies will engage in a five-day explosive ordnance disposal drill in Kochi. This advanced training initiative aims to bolster interoperability and foster teamwork between the participating units. The event will encompass expert discussions, shared training techniques, and practical exercises. This marks the eighth edition of their cooperative training, emphasizing a mutual focus on enhancing maritime security operations.
